title: Run O1, lane PERS: the personality quiz of one series, Which character are you (docs/anime/data/personality/<series-slug>.json)
description: One file per series. It holds the eight questions the engine asks (lib/personality, personality_questions) and one profile per character (personality_profiles). The loader writes the rows (scripts/anime/k1/data-load.mjs); the engine is the one of kpopquiz.org (six axes, nearest profile). Not part of docs/o1/contracts: the contract formats.md 8 describes one question set per site, this lane owner decided one quiz per series.

status.$comment: published: the page exists (personality_profiles.active true) and the launch file L10 carries the set. draft: the rows are loaded inactive on a branch, the launch file leaves the set out unless it is made with --drafts.

spoiler.$comment: The quiz's arc: the page has no spoiler shield (TWINS row 14), so the arc is 0 and every character of the quiz is spoiler free. Check C5 reads it.

questions.$comment: Exactly the eight the page asks (lib/personality/parse.ts WMA_QUESTION_COUNT), four answers each, in the order of ord.

weights.$comment: The trait weights of an answer: a position 0 to 5 on one to three axes (lib/personality/engine.ts WEIGHT_SCALE; check C1 holds it to three). 0 is the low end of the axis, a real answer, never 'no weight'.

profiles.$comment: One per character of D/series/<slug>.json. The route opens at 6 profiles.

traits.$comment: Where the character sits on the six axes, 0 to 100 (personality_profiles.axes). All six.

profile.$comment: The profile text, written by us: two to four lines, each about the reader (You ...), never a copy of a source (personality_profiles.trait_lines; the page joins them with a space).
